name: Save To Content OS: Instagram saves to Airtable (TEMPLATE)

parameters.content:
# Setup
**Accounts you need:** n8n, Airtable, Apify, Anthropic (Claude API). An iPhone if you want the one tap Shortcut.

**1. Airtable table.** Create a table with these fields (plain text is fine, Saved At can be a date): URL, Platform, Format, Source Username, Thumbnail, Caption, Transcript, Idea Card, Hook Analysis, Status, Saved At.

**2. Replace placeholders.**
YOUR_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID (starts with app) and YOUR_AIRTABLE_TABLE_ID (starts with tbl) in **Airtable dedupe** and **Airtable create**. Both are in the table's URL.
YOUR_SHARED_SECRET in **Normalize**. Make it a long random string.
Optional: CREATOR_CONTEXT in **Build enrich** so titles fit your niche.

**3. Connect credentials.**
Airtable Personal Access Token (scopes data.records:read and data.records:write) on both Airtable nodes.
Header Auth on **Apify transcript**: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
Header Auth on **Claude enrich**: name `x-api-key`, value `YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

**4. Activate, then test** in a browser:
`https://YOUR_N8N_HOST/webhook/ig-save?secret=YOUR_SHARED_SECRET&source=shortcut&url=REEL_LINK`

**5. iPhone Shortcut.** New Shortcut, turn on Show in Share Sheet (URLs only). Add Get URLs from Input, then Get Contents of URL with method GET and the URL above, with the URLs variable placed right after `url=`. Now Share on any reel and tap the Shortcut.

The Shortcut uses GET on purpose: iOS Shortcuts POST requests can fail against some hosts, GET does not.

## Save To Content OS
GET webhook. Share a reel from Instagram, the Apify actor pulls the transcript and caption, Claude writes a title, hook analysis and summary, and a row lands in your Airtable inspiration table. Deduped on the reel URL, so saving twice does nothing.
